# TechMind

> TechMind builds AI sales assistants that answer fast, qualify leads, book appointments, and follow up — with your team in control.

Website: https://techmind.it.com/
Contact: 408-624-8411 — Book Your Free AI Strategy Call.

## What TechMind does

TechMind provides AI Sales Assistants & Automation Services for businesses. An AI sales assistant captures and qualifies leads, organizes CRM updates, and prepares timely follow-ups for human approval. Nothing is sent without a human saying so. Start with one dedicated assistant and expand as your business needs grow.

## Packages (all Custom quote)

- Focus — 1 AI agent. Start with one dedicated assistant.
- Team — 2 AI agents.
- Department — 3 AI agents.
- Operations — 4 to 6 AI agents.
- Enterprise AI Team — 7 to 10 AI agents, up to a ten-agent Commander.

Add-ons: voice reception, cybersecurity, custom automation. Every package is a custom quote, priced after a consultation and written scope. Hosting, model usage, and third-party services are scoped separately.

## Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — new package, Custom quote

More buyers now ask an AI tool first — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and Gemini — instead of scrolling a list of links. AEO helps those tools find a business, understand it correctly, and quote and cite it in their answers.

AEO includes: AI crawler access (robots.txt), sitemap, llms.txt, structured data/schema, answer-first pages, and citation tracking and reporting.

No citation, ranking, or placement is guaranteed. No fake mentions or reviews. AEO is measured and maintained, not set and forgotten.

## Questions owners ask

- What does TechMind do? TechMind builds AI sales assistants that answer fast, qualify leads, book appointments, and follow up — with your team in control.
- How many AI agents do I start with? Start with one dedicated assistant (Focus) and expand as your business needs grow — up to a ten-agent Commander.
- What is AEO, and how is it different from SEO? SEO aims to rank a site in a list of links. AEO aims to get AI tools to quote and cite a business inside their answers.
